params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of messages to return per page. Defaults to `10`, maximum is `1000`.

params.name: after
params.description: Cursor for forward pagination - pass the `meta.after` value from a previous response to fetch the next page of older messages. Treat this value as an opaque cursor - do not parse, validate, or assume any format for it. **Takes precedence over `before` when both are set** (`before` is silently ignored).

params.name: before
params.description: Cursor for backward pagination - pass the `meta.before` value from a previous response to fetch the previous page of newer messages. Treat this value as an opaque cursor - do not parse, validate, or assume any format for it. Ignored when `after` is also set.

params.name: status[]
params.description: Filter by one or more derived statuses. Multiple values are OR-ed. Repeat the param for each value, e.g. `?status[]=delivered&status[]=seen`.

params.name: recipient_id[]
params.description: Filter by one or more recipient `distinct_id`s (OR-ed). Repeat the param for each value, e.g. `?recipient_id[]=user_123&recipient_id[]=user_456`.

params.name: category[]
params.description: Filter by one or more notification categories (OR-ed). Repeat the param for each value, e.g. `?category[]=transactional&category[]=promotional`.

params.name: created_at_gte
params.description: RFC3339 timestamp lower bound (inclusive). Compared against the `created_at` column which has **second precision** - sub-second components in the filter value are effectively truncated. Example: `2026-04-26T21:34:33Z`.

params.name: created_at_lte
params.description: RFC3339 timestamp upper bound (inclusive). Same second-precision caveat as `created_at_gte`. Must be `>= created_at_gte` when both are set.

params.name: workflow_slug
params.description: Filter messages triggered from a specific workflow.

params.name: idempotency_key
params.description: Filter by the idempotency key associated with the message at trigger time.

params.name: tenant_id
params.description: Filter messages belonging to a specific tenant.

params.name: is_campaign
params.description: Set `true` to return only messages sent as part of a broadcast/campaign.

params.name: object_id
params.description: Must be provided together with `object_type` to filter messages sent to an object. Will filter all message logs which were sent to recipients after object fanout.

params.name: object_type
params.description: Must be provided together with `object_id` to filter messages sent to an object. Will filter all message logs which were sent to recipients after object fanout.

items.docs: Retrieve a paginated list of messages in a workspace order by created_at desc. Can be used to fetch and show message logs on the platform.
